name: @xiranite/host-capabilities
description: The host capability surface a Xiranite node's platform adapter calls: one Promise-shaped method per host operation, with a realm transport (QuickJS `__xrh`) and a Node transport (the CLI/TUI faces).
//exports: The default resolution is the Node transport, because that is what any Node/Bun consumer gets. The QuickJS realm build does NOT resolve this map — it passes --platform=node for the npm closures, so esbuild would pick the Node transport too. `scripts/build-node-bundles.ts` therefore aliases the bare specifier to ./src/realm.ts, the same mechanism the node: builtins already use.
